verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete on the supplied evidence. The implementation validates the complete parent branch scope before both delegation paths, selects children only from parent branch/topic pairs, canonicalizes the selected subset, and signs the resulting canonical child. The load-bearing test exercises the real delegate path for both inherited and explicitly selected branches, proves malformed public parents are rejected, and includes a canonical-parent success witness. Decode also rejects alternate non-canonical encodings, while single-branch wire compatibility is preserved. The public API documentation and e2ee-ng skill are updated consistently. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or instruction-injection issue is evident. Because round 2 also had no findings and the material findings remain unchanged, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
